thread:
nina: Quick thanks to Tom and Rachel 10 — Tom dug out a spare HDMI dongle and a whiteboard marker five minutes before the all-hands, and Rachel babysat the potted cactus that escaped the window ledge :seedling: :coffee:
tom: Haha, that cactus is surprisingly dramatic. Happy to help 9. Also found a mystery travel mug in the AV cabinet; if it's yours please claim before it attains sentience :mug:
rachel: That cactus almost took a dive into the speaker stack. Glad it survived. Also shoutout to Priya for sprinting over with glue and a paper clip to MacGyver a stand :clap:
priya: I have a black belt in duct tape and paper-clip engineering. Will accept all cactus rescue medals in the form of coffee :coffee: :medal:
dan: Big thanks to the whole rescue crew . The all-hands slides didn't know what hit them. Extra points to Tom for the marker ink refill - truly underappreciated ops work :thumbsup:
devops-bot: Logged: "office-ops-rescue" by tom,rachel,priya at 2026-03-22T15:42Z. Tags: #kudos #random-rescue. Incident ID: OR-472. Reactions recorded: :thumbsup: x5 :clipboard:
nina: Also retrieving the mystery mug: it belongs to someone on Platform. I'll leave it on the kitchen shelf with a note. Thanks again everyone, we should make a mini "office rescue" sticker for the sticker wall :sparkles:
tom: Sticker motion seconded. Also vote: team coffee run at 4pm? React with :coffee: if yes, :tea: if no. Thanks y'all
